What: Fixed by PR #7897, MERGED as ff813701b31ed7c7f17334769f82b3ecac6f7449. All three defects from this issue are guarded in load_weights on main: (1) a non-object `tests` field falls back to equal weights with a named "timing seed defect: 'tests' is <type>, expected object; ignoring seed" note instead of AttributeError; (2) non-finite weights (Infinity / -Infinity / NaN) are rejected by the finite check in _weight_seconds instead of poisoning pack() with OverflowError; (3) boolean weights are rejected before the numeric check (bool is an int subclass) instead of becoming 1.0s. Regression coverage: WeightLoadingTest in pkgs/mcpx/scripts/tests/test_e2e_shard_packer.py (combined with the #6906 discovery suite during the merge resolution); verified on the merged tree — packer tests 15/15 OK, full pkgs/mcpx/scripts/tests discover 29/29 OK.
